fixtures: Empty/masked, singleton, full ascending/descending/equal, signed extrema, alternating and late replacement; all sequences over full W2 signed alphabet through length3 at N3; all ternary sequences through length5 at N7; 24 seeded arbitrary full-width sequences per profile, including maximum length
oracle: Independent O(n^2) longest-path lengths on the index/value partial-order DAG; small n<=7 exhaustive all-subsequence crosscheck; output optimal length plus exact source membership, increasing indices and strictly increasing signed values. No canonical witness tie promise. Prefix ending-length and optimum checked on every committed input.
errors: FIRST disagreement, capacity overflow with complete LAST drain, combined flags; masked fields ignored apart from FIRST/LAST/tag ownership; canonical zero error output
reset: Immediate synchronous reset at all 12 reachable states, middle search/trace/replay, held empty/error/normal output, blocked next frame; every reset followed by a complete fresh maximum-length ascending frame
on_timeout: Stop immediately; preserve TIMEOUT_NOT_RUN. No retry, no fixture reduction, no timeout increase.
